title: FloodGuard Companion Discount on the Renewal Offer Date
content:
The companion discount carried on a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy renewal offer is decided on the renewal offer date from the customer's policies in force at the same property address as the flood policy: a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, with how long it has been in force since its original effective date, or a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy.

## Terms

The companion discount on the renewal offer date is the tier's companion discount percentage plus 3 when a HomeGuard policy of the customer in force at the same property address has been in force since its original effective date for at least 60 months; the tier's companion discount percentage when a HomeGuard policy in force at the same property address has been in force for fewer than 60 months, or a LandlordGuard policy of the customer is in force at the same property address; and no companion discount otherwise.

## Schedule of combinations

| HomeGuard policy in force at the same address | LandlordGuard policy in force at the same address | Companion discount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes, in force at least 60 months since its original effective date | Yes or no | Tier's companion discount percentage plus 3 |
| Yes, in force fewer than 60 months since its original effective date | Yes or no | Tier's companion discount percentage |
| No | Yes | Tier's companion discount percentage |
| No | No | No companion discount |

## Cases (hypothetical)

Each case assumes a hypothetical tier companion discount percentage of 7.

- HomeGuard at the same address, original effective date 60 months before the renewal offer date: at least 60 months, so the discount is 7 plus 3, which is 10 percent.
- HomeGuard at the same address, original effective date 59 months before the renewal offer date: fewer than 60 months, so 7 percent.
- No HomeGuard, but a LandlordGuard policy in force at the same address: 7 percent.
- Neither policy in force at the same address: no companion discount.
